notes: Centered lane position for quiz3_app's lane centering with the DASHES detector (track_vision.detect_line) on the middle of the full camera view. Measured Nov 16 in the sunny lobby (exam venue) from a calibration pass driven centered on the yellow line. The road-surface detector misread the line there (lane found in 32/97 frames, fits cutting across the lane) and the robot drove diagonally left. Lab values: lane_center_lab.json.
